name: Koi Musubi
source:
After studying away in Taiwan, Shao-Tang finally comes back to his hometown of Nangan to be a receptionist at an inn for the summer where he works with his childhood friend Zi-Jin and enjoys the life in homeland. Everything seems the same as before, but soon becomes very different...

"Without a love knot, you will be single forever!"

When a nonsense prophecy suddenly appears, as well as a new admirer, the relationship between the two best friends begins to have a subtle change...

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/543930]Steam[/url]]
